title: How One Prayer a Night Changes What a Godly Man Wants in a Wife
caption:
How one prayer a night changes what a godly man wants in a wife.

Chase God long enough and your list changes on its own. Most guys pray for a checklist. Pray for character instead: does she run toward God when it's hard, or away from Him?

Seek first His kingdom, and the rest gets added (Matthew 6:33). Even this.

The guy desperate for a wife reeks of it. The guy chasing God becomes the guy worth marrying.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #relationships #prayer
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
